description: This is a Python script implementing a FastAPI-based server that acts as a wrapper for the Braintrust prompt API, transforming its responses into a format compatible with LiteLLM's prompt management system.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] transform_braintrust_message(message: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Transforms a Braintrust message dict into LiteLLM format, including role, content, and optionally name.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] transform_braintrust_response( braintrust_response: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Transforms the entire Braintrust API response into LiteLLM prompt management format, extracting messages, model, and parameters.

methods.name: JSONResponse get_prompt( prompt_id: str = Query(..., description="The Braintrust prompt ID to fetch"), authorization: Optional[str] = Header( None, description="Bearer token for Braintrust API" ), )
methods.description: HTTP GET endpoint that fetches a prompt from Braintrust by prompt_id, using authorization token, and returns the transformed prompt data.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning service status.

methods.name: root()
methods.description: Root endpoint providing service info and links.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function to run the FastAPI server with configuration.

ctags.name: get_prompt
ctags.signature: ( prompt_id: str = Query(..., description="The Braintrust prompt ID to fetch"), authorization: Optional[str] = Header( None, description="Bearer token for Braintrust API" ), )
